capabilities: Copy the current note as a rich hyperlink to the clipboard
Write both text/html and text/plain formats to the clipboard
Trigger copying via ribbon icon, command palette command, or hotkey
Paste as a clickable link in rich-text editors and as title plus URL in plain-text editors
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation is manual or via BRAT; no community plugin store listing is described.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in "Copy Obsidian URL" only puts the raw URL on the clipboard.
motivation: The author wanted clean clickable links to notes when pasting into editors like FuseBase, which render the raw obsidian:// URL instead of a hyperlink.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Copy Obsidian URL puts only the raw obsidian:// URL on the clipboard, which rich-text editors paste as an ugly plain string.
summary: Clipboard tool that copies the current note as a rich hyperlink so pasting into rich-text editors yields a clickable titled link.
